instruction: Design a 64-bit Johnson counter (torsional ring counter) using Verilog. The module should have a clock input, a reset input, and a 4-bit output port. The output should cycle through the following states: 0000, 1000, 1100, 1110, 1111, 0111, 0011, 0001, and back to 0000. In addition, you are only allowed to use shift register and XOR gate to finish this task.
